# Luna Dreyer

> Heidelberg-trained translator and cross-border document specialist based in Australia. Works on powers of attorney, apostille processes, and legal or official translations for documents moving between Australia and Italy, Germany, Spain or Portugal.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lunadreyer.com.au/): Overview of translation and document-liaison services for Australians dealing with European authorities.
- [Power of attorney and apostille](https://lunadreyer.com.au/power-of-attorney-apostille-australia.html): How a power of attorney is drafted, translated, notarised and apostilled in Australia for use in Europe, in the correct order.
- [Buying property in Italy from Australia](https://lunadreyer.com.au/buying-property-italy-from-australia.html): The documents and process for Australians buying Italian property remotely, including judicial auctions.
- [Heidelberg](https://lunadreyer.com.au/heidelberg.html): Background on the translator's training at Heidelberg University and why it matters for legal translation.
- [Per avvocati](https://lunadreyer.com.au/avvocati.html): Information in Italian for Italian lawyers coordinating a power of attorney with a client in Australia.
- [Get in touch](https://lunadreyer.com.au/contact.html): Contact form for enquiries; not NAATI-certified, works directly with European civil-law requirements instead.
